The following description of the apparatus which Mr. Wheatstone
uses now, will show you at once that it is not exactly the same
as he patented in the United States.
The apparatus instead of five needles has only two, and
instead of key which worked them, the two are set in appear-
ance two leaves. This sketch gives you tolerable good idea
of the apparatus, I made it from recollection, therefore not exactly correct.
